definitions: To return something to the place it was bought or where you found it.
To admit that something you said was wrong.
To accept someone back into your life or home after they have left.
To make someone remember a time in the past.
examples: I need to take back this shirt; it's too small.
I take back what I said about her; she's actually very kind.
His parents said they would take him back if he apologised.
That song always takes me back to my university days.
